column2: 1 death – A large stovepipe tornado destroyed several homes near Cisco, including one that was leveled. An unanchored hunting lodge was swept completely away, and numerous trees were denuded and partially debarked as well. A large concrete power pole was snapped, and vehicles and farm equipment were tossed more than {{convert|1|mi|km|abbr=on}}. An elderly woman was killed in the destruction of her mobile home, and one other person was critically injured.
